title: Skin Lesion Classification
summary: Comparing centralized and federated ResNet18 training on ISIC 2019.
description: Academic project with data preparation, centralized PyTorch training, Flower FedAvg simulation, and per-class evaluation.
contribution: Data preparation, training pipelines and model-comparison experiments.

title: LLM Negotiation Agents
description: Academic simulation of auctions and monotonic-concession negotiations between a house owner and construction companies, using an OpenAI-backed LLM client.
contribution: Prompt strategies for budgets, bidding and negotiation, using agent state and interaction history.

title: Q-Learning & SARSA
summary: Comparing on-policy and off-policy control in Gymnasium environments.
description: Academic experiments comparing Q-Learning and SARSA on Taxi-v3 and FrozenLake-v1, with reward plots, greedy-policy evaluation and hyperparameter comparisons.
contribution: Tabular reinforcement-learning experiments and analysis of learning rate, discount and exploration settings.

title: Drone Panorama Stitching
summary: Turning drone video frames into panoramic images.
description: Academic computer-vision pipeline using frame sampling, SIFT/ORB feature matching, RANSAC homographies, warping and blending.
contribution: Notebook-based panorama pipeline and analysis of perspective and parallax limitations.
